## Acceptance Criteria

- REQ-1 met: `GET /graph` exposes resolved `parent`, `children`, `cluster`, `rank`, and `type`, using the core hierarchy resolver at [routes.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/server/src/routes.rs:185).
- REQ-2 met: `graph_tree` publishes `GraphTreeResponse` through the schema command at [schema.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/schema.rs:429).
- REQ-3 met: full JSON export flattens the shared four-field hierarchy representation at [visualization.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/visualization.rs:223).
- REQ-4 met: scoped-resolution behavior is documented for export and tree at [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2960) and [cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2985).
- The required list envelope is restored: `count` is `nodes.len()` at [routes.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/server/src/routes.rs:221).

## Architecture and Separation of Concerns

Hierarchy resolution remains in the domain graph module. The server and commands only orchestrate storage and project resolved data. No boundary violation found.

## Functional Paradigm

The new hierarchy projections use iterator transformations and immutable resolved values. No blocking functional-style concern found.

## Correctness and Invariants

The prior review finding is resolved. The endpoint test deliberately uses three nodes and one edge, confirming that `count` describes the primary node collection.

No persistence, transition, event-log, gate, assignee, label, or PID behavior is changed.

## Safety

No unsafe code was introduced.

## Testing

Tests were not rerun because the issue has a succeeded `cargo-ci` gate, as instructed. Recorded evidence reports formatting and Clippy successful, with 3,528 tests passed, 0 failed, and 12 ignored.

Coverage includes hierarchy fields, schema publication, export/tree field agreement, and the corrected graph response count.

## Error Handling

Fallible configuration loading is propagated as an HTTP error with server-side context. No new production `unwrap()` or `expect()` was introduced.

## CLI Contract

Affected CLI commands retain `--json` support. The tree response schema is retrievable through the schema command.

## Documentation

The shared hierarchy contract and scoped-export caveat are documented for both required surfaces. Relevant public hierarchy types have descriptive documentation and examples.

## Prior Review Feedback

The sole prior finding—missing `count` in `GET /graph`—has been fixed at [routes.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/server/src/routes.rs:125) and covered by a focused endpoint test.

## Jit Issue Management

`./scripts/jit-validate.sh` passes. The issue declares no dependencies or unmet prerequisites.
